YouTube and YouTube Music cards download their sound when saved (or on their first tap). Once it is here the card plays inside BoopBox: no app switch, no ads, keeps playing in the background, works offline. Until then it opens the app as before.

Lets BoopBox see Spotify / YouTube\'s real play state, song title, artwork and progress, control them directly, skip between songs in a long video, and stop their autoplay.

Xiaomi: pop-up windows in the background
HyperOS / MIUI has an extra switch (\"Display pop-up windows while running in the background\") that BoopBox needs to come back on top. Found under Other permissions.
Some phones (Xiaomi especially) kill background apps. Set BoopBox\'s battery saver to \"No restrictions\" so playback and the come-back work reliably.
Tap the middle = play / pause. Hold the middle = stop. Top = louder, bottom = quieter. Right = next song, left = previous song. Single-song cards ignore left / right.
Any NFC thing works: blank NTAG stickers, old hotel key cards, Amiibo, transit cards. Only the card\'s ID is used unless you choose \"Write to card\" to share it.
